items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I remember the president's name, his name, he was from Boston, his name was Dr. Darling.

ctx.x: Who was the music teacher at New Orleans University?

Well, uh, I'll tell you, I remember the president's name, his name, he was from Boston, his name was Dr. Darling. But the only music I had there was, uh, was vocal, you know, though it ran me fast over one of those things, you know. So I don't quite remember. I remember one of the teachers I had, Mrs. Ennis, uh, I can't forget her because every day we went to chapel. Mm-hmm. And she would go about 11.30, staying until 12. And she'd keep her eye on me, and I'd be next, right, kept me right next to her all the…
You weren't a bad boy or anything? Oh no, no.
